title: Amazing 2 Day Trip to Morocco
text: Our family of three took the two day tour of Morocco. Since we were visiting Seville, we decided we were too close NOT to visit Morocco and Africa. The idea of DIYing the trip seemed overwhelming, so we decided to book a tour. I would recommend this tour company. It was just our family on the tour, the guides were excellent in both Tangier and Chef Chaoeuen and included personal transfer with professional drivers for all legs of the journey. We opted to include the lunches and the camel rides - the food and camel riding experience was excellent. We also stayed overnight at a Dar in the Medina
author: 370gaylea
